walkthroughs.body_html:
Evaluating and Analysing Performance for Improvement (EAPI) — a core area of A-Level PE.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Evaluating and Analysing Performance for Improvement (EAPI) brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Evaluating and Analysing Performance for Improvement (EAPI).

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
